program_name: Bachelor of Arts in International Business

programme_facts.value: The programme is structured around a broad and flexible curriculum with subject choices that will help you to understand how business decisions are undertaken in a globalised world shaped by political, social and legal issues.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study International Business at UL?

programme_facts.value: Students spend years 1, 2 and 4 in UL.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study International Business at UL?

programme_facts.value: International study and work placements in Year 3 are a core part of the programme.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study International Business at UL?

programme_facts.value: This international experience will allow you to attend university in Europe, the US, Latin America, Africa, Asia or Australia.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study International Business at UL?

programme_facts.value: Students can earn a second degree from a leading international business school by spending their first two years studying in Limerick and their last two years at another Business School while retaining an international work placement.

metadata.chunk_title: Dual Degree opportunity + Dual Degree partners:

programme_facts.value: Students will receive both UL’s BA in International Business degree and an equivalent degree from the other business school after successful completion of four years of study.
